timelineItems.title: A Day You Can Read
timelineItems.description: Each day opens with a single-line header and per-mode distance chips — how far you walked, cycled and drove, at a glance. Pick any day from the calendar and the map follows it.

timelineItems.title: Edit a Leg in Place
timelineItems.description: Tracks expand into a mode ribbon showing only the legs that matter. Got one wrong? Click the leg's mode name and change it right there. The full segment list stays tucked behind "All segments" until you ask for it.

timelineItems.title: Honest About Gaps
timelineItems.description: When tracking genuinely stopped, the timeline says so instead of drawing a straight line through the missing hours. Detected visits carry a confidence score, so a firm stay and a weak guess never look identical.

showcaseItems.title: Points
showcaseItems.description: View every location point captured with precise timestamps and details. Click any point to see its information including coordinates, time, and more.

showcaseItems.title: Polylines
showcaseItems.description: See your complete routes connecting all your location points. Visualize your journeys as continuous paths across the map.

showcaseItems.title: Heatmap
showcaseItems.description: Discover where you spend most of your time with an intensity-based heatmap visualization showing your most visited areas.

showcaseItems.title: Fog of War
showcaseItems.description: Reveal the world as you explore it. Areas you've visited are cleared while unexplored regions remain covered.

showcaseItems.title: Scratch Map
showcaseItems.description: Watch countries light up as you visit them. Perfect for travel enthusiasts tracking their global adventures.

showcaseItems.title: Places
showcaseItems.description: Save the places that matter to you, each with its own visit radius. Show their boundaries on the map and record when you arrive or leave.
showcaseItems.imageAlt: Places with their boundaries on the map

showcaseItems.title: Photos
showcaseItems.description: See your photos from Immich or PhotoPrism directly on the map at the exact locations they were taken. (fow now, only available with self-hosting)

hero.title: Explore Where You've Been,
hero.subtitle: Your location history comes alive on an interactive map with multiple visualization layers. From detailed points to beautiful heatmaps, see your life's journey in stunning detail.

mapPage.subtitle2: The map shows you where. The timeline, right beside it, shows you what happened — one day at a time, in plain language.
mapPage.subtitle3: Toggle between different map layers to see your location data in various ways. Each layer reveals unique insights about your travels and habits.
mapPage.subtitle4: Start visualizing your location history in minutes with our intuitive map interface.
mapPage.p: All your location data is stored securely with encryption at rest and in transit. Hosted in Europe and fully GDPR compliant. You can also self-host for complete control.

mapPage.p2: Start tracking your location history today with a 7-day free trial. Cancel anytime.

sections.heading: Your whole location history on one map
body: Choose any time range, from a single day to everything you have recorded, and the map shows it. Data imported from Google Timeline sits next to what your phone records today, so years of history read as one story.

sections.heading: Layers for different questions
body: Points show every recorded position, routes connect them, the heatmap shows where you spend your time, fog of war reveals the places you have been, and photos from Immich or PhotoPrism appear where they were taken. Turn layers on and off as you need them.

sections.heading: Replay a day, find a place
body: Replay plays back the points of the selected dates on the map. Search finds places and visits across your history, and the timeline panel lists your days and the places you stopped at.

sections.heading: Built for years of history
body: The map renders with WebGL, offers a 3D globe and several map styles, and loads only the part of your history you are looking at, so a decade of data stays easy to explore.

faqs.q: Can I see my old Google Timeline on this map?
faqs.a: Yes. Import your Google Timeline or Takeout export and those years appear on the map alongside new data.
Its time and coordinates, plus altitude, speed and battery level when they were recorded.

faqs.q: How far back can the map go?
faqs.a: As far as your data goes. Choose any date range, including your entire history.
